About the Project

Sheffield’s MADE4Manufacturing CDT offers advertised doctoral projects in manufacturing and digital engineering. Funded students receive a living stipend and a project-resource budget.

Research Areas

  • Manufacturing
  • Engineering
  • Digital technologies

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull Home/International tuition; GBP 35,000 project-resource budget across four years.
MaintenanceGBP 28,000/year
Duration4 years; 1 September 2027 start

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant preparation and the chosen project’s criteria. Some projects are Home-only; IELTS 6.5 overall, each component 6.0, or equivalent where required. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 projects open
DeadlineDeadline specified in the chosen project advert

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.sheffield.ac.uk/postgradapplication/

Source: sheffield.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Deadline specified in the chosen project - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Choose an advertised project and apply through its linked university route with the requested supporting documents. A research proposal is not required.

The CDT advertises PhD and EngD projects; select a PhD if that is the intended degree. Speculative applications are not accepted.

About University of Sheffield

The University of Sheffield is a research university in South Yorkshire. It offers PhD and EngD routes in manufacturing and engineering, including the MADE4Manufacturing doctoral training programme, where applicants apply to advertised research projects.
